generations.prompt: Create one item: A broad irregular flat animal hide, four short irregular side lobes, one folded-over corner showing pale suede underside. Muted warm umber/tawny brown hair-side with a few broad directional tufts and mottled patches, no face, head, horns, blood or gore; not a neat cloth rectangle and not finished leather. Slight three-quarter top view. High-resolution pixel-art master for a tiny Minecraft inventory icon, not a tiny output image. Clear broad silhouette, few major forms, crisp stepped edges and deliberately large color clusters. Material marks should occupy roughly 1-3 final pixels and stay lower contrast than structural edges. About sixteen purposeful colors, upper-left light, no gradients, microscopic detail, random noise, ground shadow, lettering, border or glow. Centered isolated item with generous margins on true transparent background. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: match the broad pixel clusters and readable material variation, not its subject, material or shape. Practical frontier craftsmanship in an alternate late nineteenth-century world; no ornamental brass or steampunk decoration.
